ImageDescription.value: The Victoria Memorial is a large marble building in Kolkata (formerly Calcutta), West Bengal, India, which was built between 1906 and 1921. It is dedicated to the memory of Queen Victoria (1819–1901) and is now a museum and tourist destination under the auspices of the Ministry of Culture. The memorial lies on the maidan (grounds) by the bank of the Hooghly River, near Jawaharlal Nehru road.

ImageDescription.value: Central Library is the main library and headquarters of the Calgary Public Library system located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. The library was designed by architectual firms Snøhetta and Calgary-based, DIALOG. The building's construction was completed in 2018 at the cost of 245 million dollars (Canadian). Central Library was officially opened on November 1, 2018. The library is located in the East Village downtown at: 800 3 Street SE, Calgary, AB T2G 2E7. The size of its collection was 450,000 items as of 2018. The library is 240,000 square feet. Its official website is: https://calgarylibrary.ca/your-library/locations/cent/
